does: Prepares a cast's hit on one target and evaluates the spell's roll against it: writes the spell's id into the hit description (+0x150 of the HitDesc it fills), the target's health percentage and the attack's position, then calls the cast's roll evaluator through its vtable (+0x40), which reaches the spell's SpellRoll condition; marks the hit as rolled.

evidence.says: copies the FixedString at +0x8 of its fifth argument into the HitDesc at +0x150, reads eoc::HealthComponent and ls::TransformComponent of the target, then makes one virtual call at +0x40 of the object in its second argument
one call per Sacred Flame cast, from +0x37D0718; the evaluation of the SpellRoll (0xFCDD50) is called from +0x3726D47 inside it

questions.ask: which object is the evaluator in its second argument, and is +0x150 of the HitDesc the spell id for every cast (read the HitDesc layout of Script Extender against a watch of a Fire Bolt hit)
